acceptance_results.criterion: Own completed allocation atomically in Scope; interruption waits cleanup acknowledgment. Fixed errors disclose no identifiers/payload/provider causes. At most one pending page; fail bounds before materialization. acceptance_results.evidence: One factory slot/atomic completed allocation and finalizer registration; callbacks execute inside acquire effect; cancel/delayedACK/release faults/poison/current-after-close tests pass with fixed causes. No payload observation API present. Initial original-Scope sentinel precedes metadata; liveness rechecked after source/current/resolve/allocation callbacks and at publication/assert completion. Six independently frozen actual-Scope regressions match full outcomes and callback/release counters.

acceptance_results.criterion: Browser APPLICATION duration allowed. Browser URLs/domain/path/visits/history/tab/window titles and all input/keystroke/cursor telemetry excluded before native observation/persistence; do not request webDomain/title/input APIs then filter. App display label is distinct from browser title; unknown classification cannot authorize excluded details. Missing labels do not omit a valid identified app.
acceptance_results.evidence: Closed request detail app_duration/app_label only; browser/input/title schema rejects before host calls; no observed excluded values/persistence. Browser app duration and absent label fixtures accepted.

acceptance_results.criterion: No synthetic source completeness from empty results, traversal exhaustion, 370-key snapshot/400-day relay or today refresh. Native capture/display/local query/export/agent destinations remain separate admission proofs.
acceptance_results.evidence: Gate publishes no zero usage/history/coverage/session claims. Empty/unavailable/today/370/400 and regrant/backup/Undo/delete frontier fixtures pass only as no-claim gate evidence.
